regime_context: Canada/TSX thematic leadership concentrates in Base Metals & Copper (rank 1, mixed trend, durability 0.71), followed by Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners. Rotation is broad (88% of themes eligible) with no single dominant narrative. The absolute-trend gate (validated risk control) is active but rank-IC is weak, making momentum a focus lens rather than a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (ca_gold) may be building durable leadership to challenge Base Metals. Watching for Gold Miners to reach rank #1 with Hurst='trend', breadth=1.0, and durability >0.75 for two consecutive weeks. Retire the watch if Base Metals & Copper holds rank #1 for four weeks from 2026-08-10 without Gold Miners closing the score gap by >50%, or if Gold Miners' Hurst flips to 'mean-revert' or durability falls below 0.60.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Strongest rank (1), high durability (0.71), full breadth (1.0) and no crowding (z=0.96, flagged false) suggest leadership concentration; the absolute-trend gate favours themes with staying power, and this one avoids a trend-break signal.
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic: The Hurst tag is 'mixed' – not a persistent trend; momentum could dissolve quickly if copper demand expectations reverse, and the margin over challengers is only 0.43, leaving leadership fragile.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 8% over any 30-day window through 2026-09-09.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Rank 2 with a high durability bar (0.76), full breadth and no crowding signal; it benefits from the same risk-control gate and sits near the top of the rotation, offering a secondary concentration point.
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic: Silver royalty themes historically swing violently with precious metals sentiment; the Hurst 'mixed' tag warns of potential whipsaws, and the score gap below the leader may narrow abruptly, turning relative momentum into a headwind.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties theme falls below rank 5 and durability drops under 0.60 by 2026-08-30.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Rank 3 with trending Hurst (0.80), the highest durability among leaders, and full breadth; no crowding adds comfort, and the absolute-trend gate supports positions in trending themes even if they are not yet the top-ranked.
evidence: Durability bar 0.80, highest in top group
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic: Gold Miners have not overtaken Base Metals as leader; if gold prices fail to sustain a bid or equity market volatility spikes, the trend could break quickly, and the score advantage over rank 4 is modest, limiting cushion.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners' Hurst tag flips to 'mean-revert' or its rank falls to 6 or lower by 2026-09-04.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
